## Agent Instructions

- **AI Chat API**: Send a POST request to `https://ggauravky.vercel.app/api/ai/chat` with `{ "message": "your question" }` to query the AI assistant directly.
- **Full knowledge base**: Fetch `https://ggauravky.vercel.app/llms-full.txt` for the complete extended documentation (26 projects, full skill matrix, all services).

- **MCP manifest**: `https://ggauravky.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json` — MCP server manifest for agent tooling.
- **Content negotiation**: Send `Accept: text/markdown` to `https://ggauravky.vercel.app/api/content` to receive the full knowledge base as Markdown.

## Featured Projects

- [SmartMess](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/smartmess): Full-stack hostel mess management platform with real-time menus, digital attendance, and admin analytics. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB.
- [InsightAudio](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/insightaudio): Autonomous AI meeting assistant — transforms recordings and YouTube videos into executive summaries, task trackers, and RAG memory. 100% self-hosted.
- [Kanoon-Mate](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/kanoon-mate): AI legal help platform that simplifies legal documents in English and Hindi with OCR, Gemini AI, and law mapping.
- [SupportPilot AI](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/supportpilot-ai): AI-powered customer support agent built at the Build With Swytchcode buildathon (Paytm Office, Noida).
- [Real-Time Chat App](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/real-time-chat-app): Live messaging application with WebSocket support. Built with React, Node.js, Socket.io.
- [BuildMyTeam](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/buildmyteam): Team-building and collaboration platform. Built with React, Node.js, MongoDB.
- [Dev Portfolio Admin Panel](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/dev-portfolio-admin-panel): Admin panel for portfolio backend management with JWT auth and analytics.
- [AiReel Studio](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/aireel-studio): AI-powered short reel generation studio.
- [FocusGuard](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/focusguard): Productivity and focus management application.
- [TrueCert](https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/truecert): Certificate verification and credential management platform.
